translations.web: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
translations.bsb: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.
translations.kjv: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.
translations.asv: The children of the third generation that are born unto them shall enter into the assembly of Jehovah.
